source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 9 (PDF 122-140), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 9 (Cybersecurity and Safe Digital Collaboration) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 8 number ka hai (definition, misalon ke saath wazahat, farq, program likh kar samjhana), aksar definition aur wazahat ke hisson mein (jaise 2 + 3 x 2). Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 A student downloads a free game from an unknown website; soon the computer slows down and unknown programs start running. (i) Explain the risks of downloading suspicious software and unsafe browsing that may explain this. (ii) Explain how troubleshooting and preventive measures should be applied, and how such a problem can be avoided in future. (8 marks)
(Aik talib-e-ilm na-maloom website se muft game download karta hai; jald computer aahista ho jata hai aur na-maloom programs chalne lagte hain. (i) Mashkook software download karne aur unsafe browsing ke woh khatre samjhayein jo is ki wajah ho sakte hain. (ii) Troubleshooting aur ehtiyati iqdamat kaise kiye jayen, aur aainda aisa masla kaise roka jaye, wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Mashkook downloads aur unsafe browsing ke khatre:
1. Na-maloom websites se programs ya files download karna computer ko nuqsan de sakta hai ya maloomat chura sakta hai.
2. Kuch downloads mein virus ya spyware chhupe hote hain jo baghair ijazat data jama karte hain; spyware chupke se maloomat jama karta hai aur virus data kharab ya delete karta hai.
3. Achanak system ka aahista hona aur na-maloom programs ka chalna mashkook sargarmi ki nishaniyan hain, is liye game ke saath ghaliban malware aaya hai.
4. Unsafe browsing, jaise jaali websites kholna ya na-maloom links par click, fraud ya identity theft ka sabab ban sakti hai.

(ii) Troubleshooting aur ehtiyati iqdamat:
1. Troubleshooting: security masle ki wajah aur hal maloom karein (system logs dekhein, scanning tools chalayen).
2. Ehtiyati iqdamat: firewall, antivirus aur anti-malware install karein; software update karein; passwords badlein; nuqsan deh files hatayen.
3. Kabhi kabhi backup se data wapas lana zaroori hota hai.
4. Masla aur uthaye gaye qadam likh lein taake dobara na ho.

Aainda bachao: download se pehle source check karein, extra hifazat ke liye antivirus rakhein aur safe browsing ki aadat apnayein.

book_ref.quote: Downloading programs or files from unknown websites can harm your computer or steal your information.

blocks.prompt:
2 Using the chapter's examples of Instagram, WhatsApp and signing up on a social platform, explain four steps a student can take to protect his or her privacy online. Also differentiate between privacy settings and a privacy policy. (8 marks)
(Chapter ki Instagram, WhatsApp aur social platform par sign up ki misalon se chaar qadam samjhayein jin se talib-e-ilm online privacy mehfooz kar sake. Privacy settings aur privacy policy mein farq bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Privacy aur security settings user ko batati hain ke us ki zaati maloomat online kaise istemal aur share ho; privacy policy batati hai ke website ya app maloomat kaise jama, store aur istemal karti hai.

Chaar qadam:
1. Instagram: account private karein taake sirf approved followers posts dekhein; location sharing band karein; extra hifazat ke liye two-factor authentication on karein.
2. WhatsApp: profile photo kaun dekhe (everyone, sirf contacts ya nobody) chunein aur read receipts (blue ticks) band karein.
3. Sign up: account banane ya terms manzoor karne se pehle privacy policy parhein. Is mein likha hota hai ke kaun sa data (naam, email, location, browsing activity, app usage) jama hoga aur kya advertisers ya third-party services ko diya jayega; phir faisla karein ke data dena hai ya nahin.
4. Jaiza aur pabandi: app permissions mehdood karein aur settings baqaidagi se dekhein, kyunke platforms privacy rules badalte rehte hain.

Farq (table dekhein).

book_ref.quote: By reviewing these policies, users can decide whether to share personal data or not.

rows: Platform par woh options jo user khud badalta hai
Website ya app ki likhi hui tehreer
Kaun posts dekhe, kaun rabta kare aur data kaise istemal ho
Data kaise jama, istemal, store aur share hota hai
Baqaidagi se dekhni chahiyein kyunke rules badalte hain
Account banane ya terms manzoor karne se pehle parhni chahiye

blocks.prompt:
3 Students often work in groups online. (i) What is safe online collaboration? (ii) Explain how Google Docs, Google Workspace and Google Meet can be used safely for group work. (iii) What is digital etiquette? Explain it with the example of a class group chat. (8 marks)
(Talaba aksar online groups mein kaam karte hain. (i) Safe online collaboration kya hai? (ii) Group kaam ke liye Google Docs, Google Workspace aur Google Meet ko mehfooz tareeqe se kaise istemal karein? (iii) Digital etiquette kya hai? Class group chat ki misal se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Online collaboration logon ko kisi bhi jagah se digital tools ke zariye mil kar kaam karne deti hai. Safe online collaboration ka matlab hai files share karte ya baat karte hue secure platforms aur hifazati usool istemal karna taake zaati aur school ka data mehfooz rahe. Is se aitmaad aur achha teamwork paida hota hai.

(ii) Platforms ka mehfooz istemal:
1. Google Docs: document sirf bharosemand classmates ko share karein; agar sirf parhna ho to permission "Edit" ke bajaye "View only" rakhein.
2. Google Workspace: project file restricted access ke saath sirf chune hue classmates ko share karein. Google Workspace aur Microsoft Teams encrypted communication aur access controls se data mehfooz rakhte hain.
3. Google Meet: secure online classes jin mein sirf authorized log shamil ho sakein.
Bharosemand aur manzoor shuda platforms chun'na cyber khatre kam karta hai.

(iii) Digital etiquette ka matlab hai online shaista, ba-ehtiram aur saaf baat karna: munasib zubaan, doosron ki raye ka ehtiram, zaati maloomat share na karna aur communication tools ka ghalat istemal na karna. Misal: class group chat mein talaba doosron ki raye ka ehtiram karein aur sanjeeda taleemi baat mein spam, ghair-mutaliq memes ya mazaq na bhejein. Is se group mufeed aur taleem par markooz rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Students learn to work responsibly in virtual groups while protecting personal and school data.

blocks.prompt:
4 Cyber threats have become common in daily life. (i) Define cybersecurity awareness and cyber threats. (ii) Explain how a user can recognize cyber threats early and avoid most attacks in daily online use. (8 marks)
(Cyber khatre rozmarra zindagi mein aam ho gaye hain. (i) Cybersecurity awareness aur cyber threats ki definitions likhein. (ii) User rozana online istemal mein cyber khatron ko jaldi kaise pehchane aur zyada tar hamlon se kaise bache, wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Cybersecurity awareness ka matlab hai computers, networks aur data ko hamlon se bachane ki samajh. Cyber threats woh actions ya programs hain jo computers aur networks ko nuqsan pohanchate hain, maslan maloomat churana, system kharab karna ya online services rokna.

(ii) Khatre pehchanna aur un se bachna:
1. Pehle khatra pehchanein: khatron ka tareeqa samajhna shuru ki nishaniyan pehchanne mein madad deta hai; yahi hifazat ka pehla qadam hai.
2. Nishaniyan dekhein: achanak aahista system, na-maloom programs, ajeeb network traffic; system logs aur scanning tools in ko dhoondte hain.
3. Safe browsing: jaali websites aur na-maloom links se bachein, emails mein ehtiyat karein, kyunke phishing (sab se aam hamla) jaali emails ya websites se passwords churata hai.
4. Antivirus: computer ko malware se bachane ke liye install karein.
5. Online banking ya hassas kaam ke liye public Wi-Fi se bachein, kyunke public networks shayad secure na hon.
6. Khabardar rehna aur khatron ko detect, prevent aur respond karna data ko mehfooz rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Understanding how threats work helps users recognize early warning signs.

blocks.prompt:
5 Data must be kept private when stored and when sent. (i) Define data protection and cryptography. (ii) Explain encryption and decryption with an example. (iii) Explain the secure methods for transmitting and storing data. (8 marks)
(Data ko store karte aur bhejte waqt private rakhna zaroori hai. (i) Data protection aur cryptography ki definitions likhein. (ii) Encryption aur decryption misal ke saath samjhayein. (iii) Data bhejne aur store karne ke mehfooz tareeqe samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Data protection ka matlab hai digital maloomat ko baghair ijazat rasai, zaya hone ya nuqsan se bachana, taake sirf sahi log data dekhein. Cryptography maloomat ko is tarah mehfooz karne ka ilm hai ke sirf authorized users samjhein.

(ii) Cryptography ke do bunyadi tasawwur:
1. Encryption aik khaas key se parhne wale data ko coded text banati hai.
2. Decryption coded text ko zaroorat par wapas asal shakal mein laati hai.
Misal: online message bhejte waqt encryption use raste mein pakarne wale ke liye na-qabil-e-faham bana deti hai; authorized wusool kunanda decrypt kar ke parhta hai. Cryptography secure websites, online banking aur messaging apps mein istemal hoti hai.

(iii) Data bhejne aur store karne ke mehfooz tareeqe:
1. Encrypted connections (jaise HTTPS) bhejte waqt maloomat mehfooz rakhte hain.
2. Cloud storage services encryption se saved files tak baghair ijazat rasai rokti hain.
3. Baqaidagi se backups system kharabi ya hamlon se data zaya hone se bachate hain.

book_ref.quote: This process ensures that information remains private during transmission.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Encryption ko aise samjhein jaise khat ko taale wale dabbe mein band karna: key ke baghair koi parh nahin sakta. Decryption usi key se dabba khol kar khat wapas parhne ke qabil banana hai.

blocks.prompt:
6 Hackers look for weak points in systems. (i) What is meant by detecting and preventing intrusions? (ii) What are vulnerabilities and suspicious activities, and how are they identified? (iii) Explain how troubleshooting and preventive measures are applied when a security issue is found. (8 marks)
(Hackers systems ki kamzor jagahen dhoondte hain. (i) Intrusions ko detect aur prevent karne se kya muraad hai? (ii) Vulnerabilities aur suspicious activities kya hain aur inhein kaise pehchana jata hai? (iii) Security masla milne par troubleshooting aur ehtiyati iqdamat kaise kiye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Intrusions ko detect aur prevent karne ka matlab hai computer ya network tak baghair ijazat rasai ko pehchanna aur rokna. Intrusion tab hoti hai jab hackers kamzoriyon se faida utha kar data churate ya system kharab karte hain. Monitoring tools aur security software ghair-maamooli sargarmi pakarte hain; jaldi pehchan bare nuqsan se bachati hai.

(ii) Vulnerabilities software, hardware ya user ke rawayye ki woh kamzoriyan hain jin se hackers faida uthate hain. Suspicious activities mein achanak aahista system, na-maloom programs ya ajeeb network traffic shamil hain. Inhein system logs baqaidagi se dekh kar aur scanning tools se pehchana jata hai; jaldi theek karne se kamyab hamle ka imkaan kam hota hai.

(iii) Troubleshooting aur ehtiyati iqdamat:
1. Troubleshooting masle ki wajah aur hal maloom karti hai.
2. Ehtiyati iqdamat: firewall, antivirus aur anti-malware install karna, software update karna, passwords badalna ya nuqsan deh files hatana.
3. Kabhi backup se data wapas lana parta hai.
4. Masla aur qadam likh lena use dobara hone se rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: Students learn how early detection prevents major losses and keeps systems running safely.

blocks.prompt:
7 Technology lets people work together from different places. (i) Define digital collaboration and equity in computing. (ii) Explain the importance of teamwork and communication in digital environments. (iii) Explain how real-time collaboration tools help teams, naming the platforms given in the chapter. (8 marks)
(Technology logon ko mukhtalif jagahon se mil kar kaam karne deti hai. (i) Digital collaboration aur equity in computing ki definitions likhein. (ii) Digital mahol mein teamwork aur communication ki ahmiyat samjhayein. (iii) Real-time collaboration tools teams ki kaise madad karte hain, chapter ke platforms ke naam ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Digital collaboration technology se mushtarka kaam, projects ya ideas par mil kar kaam karna hai; log mukhtalif jagahon se internet ke zariye jurte hain. Equity in computing yaqeeni banati hai ke har shakhs, pas-e-manzar ya salahiyat se qata nazar, barabar digital wasail tak pohanche. Dono mil kar shamil aur mo'assar mahol banate hain.

(ii) Digital mahol mein teamwork aur communication:
1. Teamwork ke liye saaf communication aur aitmaad zaroori hai; jab sab ideas dein aur doosron ko sunein to project hamwar chalta hai.
2. Mo'assar communication ghalat fehmi se bachati aur sab ko pesh raft se baakhabar rakhti hai.
3. Group chats, emails aur video calls team ko jore rakhte hain.
4. Achha teamwork takhleeq, taawun aur mushtarka zimmedari barhata hai; online kaam talaba ko remote work wale jadeed daftaron ke liye tayyar karta hai.

(iii) Real-time collaboration tools kai users ko aik hi waqt mein aik project par kaam karne dete hain. Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams aur Zoom documents share karna, chat aur online meeting aasan banate hain. Teams kaam tarteeb deti, files mil kar edit karti aur fauran update rehti hain; is se waqt bachta aur ghaltiyan kam hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: It allows people to connect and contribute from different places using the internet.

blocks.prompt:
8 Technology should be usable by everyone. (i) What is meant by designing for equity and accessibility, and by equal access? Name the challenges some people face. (ii) Explain how developers can create inclusive applications for diverse users. (8 marks)
(Technology har kisi ke liye qabil-e-istemal honi chahiye. (i) Equity aur accessibility ke liye design aur equal access se kya muraad hai? Kuch logon ko darpesh mushkilat ke naam likhein. (ii) Developers mukhtalif users ke liye inclusive applications kaise bana sakte hain, wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Equity aur accessibility ke liye design ka matlab hai technology aisi banana ke har koi, mukhtalif salahiyaton aur pas-e-manzar wale log bhi, istemal kar sakein.
Equal access ka matlab hai har shakhs ko technology aur internet ka barabar mauqa mile, yani bharosemand devices, internet connection aur digital skills tak rasai.
Mushkilat: mazoori, zubaan ki rukawat ya wasail ki kami. Inhein samajh kar developers aise hal banate hain jo sab tak pohanchein, taake digital duniya mein koi peeche na rahe. Accessible design mazoor logon ko faida deta aur sab ke liye istemal aasan karta hai.

(ii) Inclusive applications banana:
1. Nazar se mazoor logon ke liye screen readers.
2. Videos ke liye subtitles.
3. Kai zubaanon ke options.
4. Saada layout aur saaf text, jo naye users ke liye aasan hai.
5. Designs ko mukhtalif users ke saath test karna.
Inclusive tools barabari ko sahara dete aur user ka tajurba behtar karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Understanding these issues helps developers and organizations design solutions that reach everyone.

blocks.prompt:
9 Effective collaboration helps teams complete tasks successfully. Explain the five strategies for effective collaboration given in the chapter. (8 marks)
(Mo'assar collaboration teams ko kaam kamyabi se mukammal karne deti hai. Chapter mein di gayi paanch strategies samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Mo'assar collaboration: jab sab apni zimmedari samjhein aur saaf baat karein to teamwork mazboot hota hai; planning, tarteeb aur ideas share karna project ko baghair uljhan aage barhata hai, aur log mukhtalif raye ka ehtiram seekhte hain.

1. Roles assign karna: wazeh roles har member ko batate hain ke kya karna hai, maslan aik research, doosra maloomat ki tarteeb, teesra aakhri presentation.
2. Tasks manage karna: checklists ya timelines team ko raah par rakhti aur der se bachati hain.
3. Team goals tay karna: mushtarka goals sab ko simt dete aur taawun barhate hain; wazeh roles aur goals se teamwork aasan hota hai.
4. Tajurbaat par ghaur: project ke baad sochna ke kya achha raha aur kya behtar ho sakta tha; taaqat (achhi communication) aur kamzori (missed deadlines) pehchanna.
5. Teamwork behtar karne ke liye guftagu: in tajurbaat par baat se talaba ghaltiyon se seekhte aur behtar team player bante hain; waqt ke saath teamwork mazboot hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Planning, organizing, and sharing ideas allow group projects to move forward without confusion.

blocks.prompt:
10 Entrepreneurs turn ideas into businesses. (i) Explain the characteristics of successful entrepreneurs. (ii) Describe how entrepreneurship is growing in Pakistan's digital economy. (8 marks)
(Entrepreneurs ideas ko karobar mein badalte hain. (i) Kamyab entrepreneurs ki khoobiyan samjhayein. (ii) Pakistan ki digital economy mein entrepreneurship kaise barh rahi hai, bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Kamyab entrepreneurs ki khoobiyan:
1. Takhleeqi: hamesha masail hal karne ke naye ideas dhoondte hain.
2. Mehnati: apne goals ke paband rehte hain.
3. Pur-aitmaad aur soch samajh kar risk lene wale (zyada tar paidaishi risk lene wale nahin hote, tajurbe se seekhte hain).
4. Faisla saazi aur masail hal karne ki mazboot salahiyat.
5. Adaptable: badalte market halaat aur customers ki zarooriyat ke mutabiq dhal jate hain.

(ii) Pakistan mein entrepreneurship aur digital economy:
1. Internet aur mobile technology tak barhti rasai ki wajah se tezi se barh rahi hai.
2. Bohat se naujawan social media, e-commerce platforms aur freelancing websites se online karobar shuru kar rahe hain.
3. Digital economy software development, digital marketing aur online services mein nayi naukriyan paida kar rahi hai.
4. Sarkari aur nijji iqdamat startups aur innovation ki madad kar rahe hain.
Yeh taraqqi mulki maeeshat behtar karti aur naujawanon ko naukri dhoondne ke bajaye naukri dene wala banati hai.

book_ref.quote: Successful entrepreneurs are creative and always look for new ideas to solve problems.

blocks.prompt:
11 Every business starts from a real need. (i) What is meant by identifying business opportunities? (ii) Explain how technology solves real-world problems, with examples. (iii) Explain how entrepreneurs recognize market needs and customer demands. (8 marks)
(Har karobar kisi haqeeqi zaroorat se shuru hota hai. (i) Karobari mauqe pehchanne se kya muraad hai? (ii) Technology haqeeqi masail kaise hal karti hai, misalon ke saath samjhayein. (iii) Entrepreneurs market ki zarooriyat aur customers ki talab kaise pehchante hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Karobari mauqe pehchanne ka matlab hai muashre ke woh masail dhoondna jo products ya services se hal hon. Entrepreneurs rozmarra zindagi dekh kar customers ki zarooriyat samajhte hain. Technology online education, e-commerce aur digital services jaise mauqe dikhati hai. Pakistan mein zaraat, sehat aur taleem mein bohat se mauqe hain (Figure 9.4 taleem, sehat, zaraat aur karobar ko chaar alag shobon ke taur par dikhati hai).

(ii) Technology se haqeeqi masail ka hal: technology entrepreneurs ko taleem, sehat, zaraat aur karobar mein tez aur behtar digital hal banane deti hai. Misalein:
1. Online learning platforms talaba ko ghar se parhne dete hain.
2. Mobile apps kisanon ko fasal ki paidawar barhane mein madad deti hain.
3. Digital payment systems len den aasan aur mehfooz banate hain.

(iii) Market ki zarooriyat pehchanne ka matlab hai samajhna ke log kya chahte hain aur unhein kya masail hain. Entrepreneurs customers ka rawayya, pasand aur trends parhte hain; surveys, feedback aur online data market ke khala dikhate hain. Customers ki zaroorat poori karna kamyabi laata hai; digital economy mein online trends aur feedback ka tajziya bohat ahem hai.

book_ref.quote: Successful entrepreneurs focus on solving real-world problems in innovative ways.

blocks.prompt:
12 A student wants to start selling handmade items online. Explain how she can use the three kinds of digital platforms for entrepreneurship (social media, e-commerce platforms, freelancing and remote work) and the benefits of each. (8 marks)
(Aik talibah online haath se bani cheezein bechna chahti hai. Samjhayein ke woh entrepreneurship ke teen qism ke digital platforms (social media, e-commerce platforms, freelancing aur remote work) kaise istemal kar sakti hai aur har aik ke kya faide hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Digital platforms entrepreneurs ko online karobar shuru karne, chalane aur barhane ke tools dete hain; in mein social media, e-commerce websites aur freelancing marketplaces shamil hain (Figure 9.5).

1. Social media: products ki promotion aur jaldi bari audience tak pohanch. Woh apni cheezein bohat se logon ko dikha kar karobar ki pehchan bana sakti hai.
2. E-commerce platforms aur online marketplaces: internet par products aur services bechne dete hain aur baghair jismani dukaan ke sellers ko customers se jorte hain. Customers products dekhte, qeematein milate aur online order karte hain. Khareed o farokht aasan, tez aur zyada logon tak hoti hai, kharche kam aur market bari hoti hai.
3. Freelancing aur remote work: freelancing websites logon ko graphic design, writing, programming aur digital marketing jaise shobon mein duniya bhar ke clients ko skills dene deti hain; remote work ghar ya internet wali kisi jagah se company ke liye kaam hai. Is se lachak, khud mukhtar aamdani aur aalami job market milti hai (woh design services bhi de sakti hai).

Yeh platforms mil kar entrepreneurship ko aasan banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Digital platforms provide entrepreneurs with tools to start, manage, and grow their businesses online

blocks.prompt:
13 A digital business needs a clear plan. (i) Explain the steps of planning a small digital business and the basic business planning concepts. (ii) Explain budgeting and resource management. (iii) Why are teamwork and communication essential in startups? (8 marks)
(Digital karobar ko wazeh plan chahiye. (i) Chhote digital karobar ki planning ke qadam aur business planning ke bunyadi tasawwurat samjhayein. (ii) Budgeting aur resource management samjhayein. (iii) Startups mein teamwork aur communication kyun zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Chhote digital karobar ki planning ka matlab hai ideas ko wazeh aur qabil-e-amal plan mein dhalna:
1. Customers ki zaroorat poori karne wala product ya service chunein.
2. Target audience, qeemat aur digital platforms se delivery ka tareeqa tay karein.
3. Kharchon aur mutawaqqa aamdani ke liye basic budget banayein.
Bunyadi tasawwurat: karobar ke wazeh goals, target market ki samajh, customers ko qadr dene ka tareeqa, aur waqt, paisa aur skills jaise wasail ki planning. Saada business plan ideas ko tarteeb aur simt deta hai (zyada tar nakam startups ke paas wazeh plan nahin hota).

(ii) Budgeting aur resource management ka matlab hai paisa, waqt aur doosre wasail ke istemal ki planning. Budget kharchon ka andaza, qeematein aur aamdani-kharch sambhalne mein madad deta hai. Resource management saman, skills aur tools ko baghair zaya kiye istemal karwata hai. Dono munafa aur lambi kamyabi barqarar rakhte hain.

(iii) Team members ideas, zimmedariyan aur skills share kar ke mushtarka goals hasil karte hain. Mo'assar communication ghalat fehmi se bachati aur faisle behtar karti hai; meetings, messaging apps aur online tools se wazeh rabta kaam hamwar rakhta hai. Is se paidawar aur karobar barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Planning a small digital business involves organizing ideas into a clear and workable plan.

blocks.prompt:
14 New technologies are changing business. (i) Define innovation and explain its role in digital entrepreneurship. (ii) Explain how emerging technologies and AI, apps and digital services help businesses. (iii) Name the career pathways in technology entrepreneurship. (8 marks)
(Nayi technologies karobar ko badal rahi hain. (i) Innovation ki definition likhein aur digital entrepreneurship mein is ka kirdar samjhayein. (ii) Emerging technologies aur AI, apps aur digital services karobar ki kaise madad karti hain? (iii) Technology entrepreneurship mein career raaston ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Innovation naye aur behtar ideas, products ya services banana hai jo masail behtar hal karein. Yeh digital karobar ko barhne aur muqable mein rehne deti hai aur badalti market ki zarooriyat ke mutabiq products banane mein ahem hai. AI, mobile apps aur online platforms ki wajah se mustaqbil ke mauqe barh rahe hain.

(ii) Artificial intelligence, cloud computing, blockchain aur mobile applications jaisi emerging technologies entrepreneurship badal rahi hain: zyada smart, tez aur behtar hal, kam kharche, zyada paidawar aur aalami rasai; startups inhein jadeed products ke liye istemal karte hain.
1. AI data ka tajziya, customers ka rawayya samajhne aur behtar faislon mein madad deti hai.
2. Mobile apps customers tak pohanchna, products bechna aur jaldi services dena aasan banati hain.
3. Online payments, cloud storage aur marketing tools karkardagi barhate aur kharche kam karte hain.

(iii) Career raaste: startup founder; programming, graphic design ya digital marketing mein freelancer; app developer; e-commerce manager; online consultant; haqeeqi masail ke naye digital hal banane wala innovator.

book_ref.quote: By adopting innovation, individuals can build successful and future-ready digital businesses.

blocks.prompt:
15 Computing has ethical effects. (i) Explain the ethical use of technology. (ii) Explain intellectual property and data ownership and how they should be respected. (iii) Explain the consequences of unethical digital behavior. (8 marks)
(Computing ke akhlaqi asraat hain. (i) Technology ka ethical istemal samjhayein. (ii) Intellectual property aur data ownership aur un ke ehtiram ka tareeqa samjhayein. (iii) Ghair-akhlaqi digital rawayye ke nataij samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Technology ke ethical istemal ka matlab hai zimmedari se kaam karna aur digital kaamon se nuqsan na pohanchana. Is mein privacy, insaaf aur maloomat ki sahi dekh bhaal ka ehtiram shamil hai. Technology ke faislon mein logon, idaron aur muashre par asar ka khayal rakhna chahiye. Baghair ijazat online content copy karna copyright qawaneen aur digital ethics dono ki khilaf warzi hai.

(ii) Intellectual property software, music ya tehreer jaisa takhleeqi kaam hai. Data ownership apni zaati maloomat par ikhtiyar ka haq hai. In ka ehtiram yeh hai ke baghair ijazat kaam copy, share ya istemal na karein aur zaati, hassas maloomat ki hifazat karein. Is se insaaf barhta aur takhleeq karne wale aur users mehfooz rehte hain.

(iii) Ghair-akhlaqi rawayye mein hacking, jhooti maloomat phailana aur cyberbullying shamil hain. Yeh nuqsan dete, saakh kharab karte aur qanooni kaarwai tak le jate hain; chhota online kaam bhi bara asar rakh sakta hai. Akhlaqi mayar mehfooz aur bharosemand online mahol yaqeeni banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Following ethical guidelines helps maintain trust and safety online.

16 Laws protect people and data in the digital world. (i) What are data privacy laws, and what is cybercrime? (ii) Compare the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) with Pakistan's Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (PECA) 2016 in a table. (8 marks)
(Qawaneen digital duniya mein logon aur data ki hifazat karte hain. (i) Data privacy qawaneen kya hain aur cybercrime kya hai? (ii) General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) aur Pakistan ke Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (PECA) 2016 ka table mein muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Data privacy qawaneen woh qanooni qawaid hain jo zaati data ke jama, store, istemal aur share hone ki hifazat karte hain. Cybercrime computers, networks ya internet se kiye gaye ghair-qanooni kaam hain, maslan hacking, identity theft aur online fraud. Yeh qawaneen afraad, idaron aur muashre ki hifazat aur online nizam par aitmaad barhate hain.

(ii) GDPR aur PECA 2016 ka muqabla (table dekhein).

book_ref.quote: Many countries and companies follow similar standards to ensure data privacy globally.
